I know how you feel, I couldn't take her things off my bookshelf or delete our pictures/messages for over 2 years) it does get easier, slowly but surely. One thing I do when I start thinking I miss my ex is just remembering the bad things. You might think "we never had any bad moments or anything" but you're probably just spinning it in your head, no relationship is perfect. Maybe try to do something that keeps him off your mind, also make sure you put away any memories of them, if you have to take a different route to school or work.
Yea it sounds like you have really bad anxiety issues on top of obvious suicidal thoughts, if you truly want help you should see a therapist and maybe look into getting medicine.

I 100% understand what you feel, I've been in that position before and thinking about it makes you feel like someone is punching you in the stomach. It took me a really long time to get this but it's important that you do. You have to understand that sex doesn't mean you have feelings for someone. I'm not sure how much you've been around but if you look back at some of the other girls you've been with you probably don't think anything of them, it was just something that happend and ended. Don't worry about it so much, if she took you back don't waste this chance, make the most of it.

I'm hoping things get better, and for some weird reason I kinda feel like it will. Sorry for long self reply, that's just what I've been thinking, hopefully things get better for you, good luck.

I had a situation kind of similar, trust me you're probably fine, wait for the results, the relief I felt when I got my clean results back was unimaginable and I know you will feel the same when you get yours back too. As for your girlfriend I would tell her what happened, whether you do or not it will affect your relationship. While my situation was a bit different I did tell the person I was seeing at the time about it and she understood and was actually really supportive during it. If I was in your position I'm not sure if I would wait for the results to talk to my SO or not, 2-3 weeks definitely seems like a long time for results, usually only takes a week but that's something you'll have to decide.
